title: Tab works down the range ends, and Alt+Down opens a rule picker
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, three ranges, Default on Markup %.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name on the Matrices list.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Click the first range's end.
  5. Press Tab.
  6. Click Default's first range value.
  7. Press Alt+Down.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Matrix A is listed.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The first range's end has focus.

Step 5:

  • Focus moves to the second range's end.

Step 6:

  • Default's first value has focus.

Step 7:

  • That range's symbol picker opens with + $, Markup % and Margin %.
